senses.definition: (intransitive) To have enough courage (to do something).
examples: I wouldn't dare (to) argue with my boss.
No one dares (to) criticize his decisions.
They daredn't tell me the truth, even though I dared (to) acknowledge my mistake to them.
I daren't tell him I've had an affair with another man.

quotes.text: The fellow dares not deceive me.

senses.definition: (transitive) To have enough courage to meet or do something, go somewhere, etc.; to face up to.
examples: Will you dare death to reach your goal?
